mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows the model to invent a state where an AuditEntry is modified (same task, actor, operation but different entry), which is exactly what the AppendOnly and AuditImmutable assertions are supposed to catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditNotImmutable { some disj ae1, ae2: AuditEntry | ae1.task = ae2.task and ae1.actor = ae2.actor and ae1.operation = ae2.operation and ae1 != ae2 }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact lets the model invent a share where the sharee equals the owner, violating the ownership-based access control pattern. This tests that only the owner can control the share list.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ShareeEqualsOwner { some ts: TaskShare, to: TaskOwnership | ts.task = to.task and ts.sharee = to.owner }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows the model to invent cross-team shares, violating FR-012. The assertion checks that all sharees belong to the same team as the task owner.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossTeamShare { some ts: TaskShare, to: TaskOwnership, utaS: UserTeamAssignment, utaO: UserTeamAssignment | ts.task = to.task and utaS.user = ts.sharee and utaO.user = to.owner and utaS.team != utaO.team }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact lets the model invent a state where a user from a different team can access (share or ownership) a task, directly violating the cross-team isolation guarantee and byte-equivalent 404 requirements.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossTeamAccess { some u: User, t: Task, utaU: UserTeamAssignment, to: TaskOwnership, ts: TaskShare | utaU.user = u and to.task = t and ts.task = t and ts.sharee = u and utaU.team != to.team }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact lets the model invent a task with a TaskOwnership but no corresponding Created audit entry, violating the requirement that every task mutation produces an audit entry.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoAuditForCreation { some t: Task | (some to: TaskOwnership | to.task = t) and (no ae: AuditEntry | ae.task = t and ae.operation = Created) }
